question_en: A good driving attitude of a driver is to:
explanation_en: Defensive drivers maintain focus on the road, they keep their hands at the wheel at 10 o'clock and 2 o'clock position. They refrain from doing other tasks while driving. E.g. texting, eating, applying makeup.

question_en: Are children below 6 years old allowed to sit in the passenger seat beside the driver?
explanation_en: If apprehended your driver’s license shall be confiscated and suspended for a period of twelve (12) months upon final conviction by a regular court.

question_en: Which of the following is the maximum speed limit on expressway for cars?
explanation_en: The maximum speed limit on expressways is 100kph for cars and motorbikes (at least 400cc); and 80kph for trucks and buses. The minimum speed on expressways is 60kph.

question_en: Drivers gather most information using their:
explanation_en: Drivers get the most information through the use of their vision. This is the reason why road and traffic signs are visually noticeable instead of making it audible.

question_en: Yellow triangular signs provide what kind of information?
explanation_en: Yellow triangular signs are used to alert drivers of possible dangers or road conditions ahead so they can slow down and drive carefully.

question_en: Double solid yellow lane lines:
option_a_en: should not be crossed except with due care
explanation_en: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing or crossing is allowed in either direction. They are used to separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions where visibility or safety makes overtaking dangerous.

question_en: Under what circumstances should you sound your "horn"?
explanation_en: The horn should only be used to alert other drivers or pedestrians to prevent an accident or warn of potential danger — not to make noise in sensitive areas like schools or hospitals.

question_en: You were apprehended because you were engaged in car racing while driving in a super highway, what traffic violation did you commit?
explanation_en: Presidential Decree No. 1865 states that the penalty for speed contests and rallies without official permit is as follows: "Any person who commits any act herein prohibited shall, upon conviction, be punished with a fine of not less than ₱20,000 but not more than ₱50,000, or imprisonment of at least two years but not more than five years, or both, in the discretion of the court."

question_en: You are in a no-passing zone when the center of the road is marked by:
explanation_en: This marking means no overtaking or passing is allowed in either direction. It is used in areas where visibility is limited or it’s dangerous to pass, such as curves, hills, or intersections.

question_en: What does the lane require you to do upon approaching an intersection with a stop sign?
option_a_en: slow down and proceed when it is safe to do so
option_b_en: stop and proceed when it is safe to do so
option_c_en: yield the right-of-way if necessary to vehicles approaching from left or right
explanation_en: A stop sign means you must make a complete stop, check for incoming vehicles or pedestrians, and only move once the way is clear and safe.

question_en: When may you lend your driver's license?
option_b_en: when another person needs to learn how to drive
explanation_en: A driver's license could be used only by the person who's picture and name is printed on it. Lending it to another could result into a fine or suspension or even revocation of your driver's license.

question_en: The license issued to a driver shall entitle him to operate:
option_a_en: only motor vehicle/s that he can drive
option_c_en: only motor vehicle/s specified in the license
explanation_en: All LTO-issued licenses have an indicated vehicle type allowed to be driven per license classification.

question_en: A person whose driver's license is under suspension may:
option_a_en: operate a motor vehicle in a case of extreme emergency
option_b_en: not operate a motor vehicle under any condition
option_c_en: operate a motor vehicle when accompanied by a licensed driver
explanation_en: When a driver’s license is suspended, it means the person temporarily loses the privilege to drive. Operating a vehicle during suspension is a serious violation that may lead to license revocation and heavier penalties.

question_en: The driver of a car traveling on a highway is required to yield to:
option_a_en: any car coming out of a driveway
option_c_en: cars approaching an intersection from the left
explanation_en: Pedestrians always have the right-of-way at crosswalks and intersections. Drivers must stop or slow down to let them cross safely, especially on highways or busy roads.

question_en: When you do not see the wheels of the vehicles in front of you, should you do?
option_a_en: slow down and get back to a safer following distance
option_c_en: increase your speed until it becomes visible
explanation_en: If you can’t see the rear wheels of the vehicle ahead, it means you’re too close. Keeping a safe distance gives you enough time to react if the vehicle in front suddenly stops or slows down, reducing the risk of collision.

question_en: To have one's driver's license suspended means to:
option_a_en: have it revalidated by the LTO
option_b_en: have it taken away permanently by the LTO
option_c_en: have it taken temporarily by the LTO
explanation_en: Driver's license suspension would be a result of a traffic violation. In order to regain your license back you'll have to comply with the penalty and fines of the specific violation.

question_en: Which of the following should you do if you feel drowsy while driving?
option_a_en: pull off the road and rest
option_b_en: move over to the right lane and continue driving
option_c_en: increase your speed to get away from other vehicles
explanation_en: If you feel drowsy while driving, you should pull over safely and take a rest. Driving while sleepy greatly reduces your reaction time and focus, increasing the risk of accidents. Resting helps you regain alertness and drive safely.

question_en: The most effective way to deal with a "tailgater" is to:
option_a_en: ignore him but don't allow him to get very close to you
option_b_en: slow down and let him pass
option_c_en: increase your speed and slam on your brakes
explanation_en: The safest and most effective way to deal with a tailgater. Speeding up or braking suddenly can cause accidents, but slowing down slightly gives the tailgater a chance to overtake safely and reduces the risk of a rear-end collision.

question_en: Which of the following is most recommended in a way of dealing with fatigue on a long trip?
option_a_en: stop periodically for rest and exercise
option_b_en: eat much and drink a little alcoholic beverages
explanation_en: Taking regular breaks helps your body and mind recover from fatigue, keeping you alert and safe while driving. Eating heavily or taking pills is not a healthy or reliable way to fight tiredness.

question_en: What traffic violation have you committed if you pick-up passengers on prohibited zones?
option_c_en: obstructing the free flow of traffic
explanation_en: Picking up passengers in prohibited zones disrupts the smooth movement of vehicles, causes congestion, and endangers other road users. It’s a violation because it blocks traffic flow and creates unnecessary delays.

question_en: If there are pedestrians on a school crossing, you are required to:
option_a_en: stop and give way only to persons crossing from your right
option_b_en: stop only for children and give way to them from either direction
option_c_en: stop and do not proceed until all persons are completely clear off the crossing
explanation_en: Drivers must completely stop and wait until all pedestrians have safely crossed. This ensures the safety of students and others using the crosswalk, especially in school zones where extra caution is required.

question_en: The main reasons for requiring a motor vehicle inspection is to:
option_b_en: give the inspector a chance to look at your car
option_c_en: try and make sure that cars meet safety standards
explanation_en: Vehicle inspection is done prior to its registration. This is conducted annually to ensure that the motor vehicle is still in good and safe condition.

question_en: A driver is considered a professional if:
option_c_en: he is paid or earns money while driving a private or public vehicle
explanation_en: Professional drivers are those who drive for a living. To do that they must have a Professional driver's license.

question_en: Ignoring traffic lights during late night could:
option_b_en: involve you in a fatal accident
explanation_en: Observe and follow road and traffic signs at all times. They are there for safety and organizational reasons. Driving during late night doesn't mean you can violate them with the absence of traffic enforcers.

question_en: A pre-trip inspection should be completed:
option_a_en: before and after operating the motor vehicle
explanation_en: Doing a pre-trip inspection must be done before hitting the road. The most important reason to do it is for your safety. It can be very dangerous to go out on the road with damaged brakes, compromised wiring, or unsecured load. This especially applies to trucks and other heavy vehicles but should also be done for cars and even motorbikes.

question_en: As you drive, your glances to the side and rear-view mirrors should be:
explanation_en: Mirror checks should be quick to avoid losing focus on the road ahead. Prolonged glances can distract you and increase the risk of accidents.

question_en: A privately registered car utilized for hire and carriage of passengers or cargoes is a colorum vehicle and is prohibited by law. Drivers caught operating such vehicle for the first time is penalized by:
option_a_en: a fine of Php 2,000 and suspension of his driver's license for three months
explanation_en: Never use a privately registered vehicle for hire to transport cargoes or passengers. If you plan to use it to carry passengers or cargoes, you've got to make sure that it's properly registered with the LTFRB (Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board) and LTO (Land Transportation Office).

question_en: The motor vehicle plate and driver's license may be confiscated by any authorized LTO agent when the vehicle being operated is found to be:
option_b_en: painted with color not approved by LTO
explanation_en: The LTO may confiscate the license and plate of any vehicle that is not roadworthy because such vehicles pose danger to the driver, passengers, and other road users. Regular maintenance is required to ensure safety on the road.

question_en: What is considered as a parking violation?
option_c_en: parking within 5 meters from a signalized intersection
explanation_en: Parking too close to an intersection — especially one with traffic lights or signals — blocks the view of other drivers and pedestrians. It can obstruct traffic flow, cause accidents, and make it harder for vehicles to turn safely.

question_en: What is the meaning of a blinking red traffic light?
option_c_en: stop for a while and go if there is no danger ahead
explanation_en: A blinking or flashing red traffic light means you must treat it like a stop sign. You have to come to a full stop, check the road for any vehicles or pedestrians, and proceed only when it’s safe. It’s not a signal to speed up, but to move cautiously after making sure the intersection is clear.

question_en: According to the Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999 (R.A. No. 8749):
option_a_en: all road users has the right to breathe clean air
option_b_en: every citizen must strive for their right to breathe clean air
option_c_en: every citizen has the right to breathe clean air
explanation_en: Philippine Clean Air Act, is a comprehensive air quality management policy and program which aims to achieve and maintain healthy air for all Filipinos. Lifted from: Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

question_en: Driving with a fake license is prohibited and is punishable by:
option_a_en: not more than 6 months of imprisonment
option_c_en: Php 3,000.00 fine with 12-month suspension of driver's license
explanation_en: Using or possessing a fake driver’s license is a serious offense under LTO regulations because it involves fraud and endangers public safety. The law imposes both a fine and a suspension to discourage the use of counterfeit licenses.

question_en: Which of the following are not considered "highways"?
option_b_en: roadway upon property owned by private persons or universities
explanation_en: Roads other than public roads and highways are called private roads. These roads don't follow speed limits that are mandated by law since they have their own. E.g. on some schools and subdivision the speed limit is 10kph.

question_en: The speed limit signs along the roadways should be thought of as:
option_a_en: the recommended speed under the best road condition
option_b_en: the recommended speed under the worst road condition
option_c_en: the recommended speed under any road condition
explanation_en: Imposed speed limits on roads are recommended under the assumption that the roads are in the best condition (i.e. dry, without potholes or heavy traffic, good lighting). So, in case the road is wet, let's say in an expressway, then it's safest to drive way slower than the maximum speed limit and not slower than the minimum speed limit at the same time.

question_en: If the driver will be under medication, he should:
option_b_en: consult a doctor about the effects before driving
option_c_en: get some rest first before driving
explanation_en: It's unsafe to drive especially if you are taking medicines that might affect driving. It is best to consult your doctor if you're unsure. Some of these drugs are sleeping pills, muscle relaxants, anti-depressants, and pain relievers - just to cite a few.

question_en: Which of the following can you adjust in order to reduce the chance of collision?
explanation_en: To reduce the risk of being involved in a car crash you must always observe the speed limits and correct road position.

question_en: Night driving is dangerous because:
option_a_en: street lights tend to blur your vision
option_b_en: more vehicles are on the road at night
option_c_en: the distance we can see ahead is reduced
explanation_en: Imposed speed limits on roads are recommended under the assumption that the roads are in the best condition (i.e., dry, without potholes or heavy traffic, good lighting). Let's say you're driving at night in an expressway with poor lighting, you wouldn't want to drive close to the max speed limit; instead, you would want to drive slower than the maximum speed limit and not slower than the minimum speed limit because it's safer to do so.

question_en: One that affects your visibility while driving is?
explanation_en: Of course, all of the choices would affect your visibility while driving. However, among the three choices, you only have control over your headlights, so be sure to check it and keep it clean before you drive.

question_en: The three colors of the traffic lights are:
explanation_en: These are the standard traffic light colors used worldwide—red means stop, yellow means prepare to stop, and green means go.

question_en: The Right-of-Way law provides us with:
option_b_en: rules for when to yield to others
explanation_en: The Right-of-Way law defines who should go first and who should yield in different driving situations to prevent accidents and maintain smooth traffic flow.

question_en: At rotundas, which of the following vehicles have the right-of-way?
option_a_en: vehicles which are just about to enter
explanation_en: Drivers already inside the roundabout have the right-of-way. Vehicles entering must wait until it is safe to join to avoid collisions and keep traffic moving smoothly.

question_en: Should a driver turning at an intersection give way to pedestrians?
option_a_en: Yes, a driver turning right or left must give way to pedestrians
option_b_en: No, pedestrians must give way to all vehicles
option_c_en: Yes, but only if the driver is turning left
explanation_en: When a driver turns right or left at an intersection, they must always yield to pedestrians crossing the street. This ensures pedestrian safety and prevents accidents, especially at marked crosswalks.

question_en: A type of field sobriety test that requires the driver to walk heel-to-toe along a straight line for nine (9) steps, turn at the end and return to the point of origin without any difficulty. What is this test called?
explanation_en: This test checks the driver’s balance, coordination, and ability to follow instructions — skills that are usually impaired when under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

question_en: It refers to measure of amount of alcohol in a person’s blood.
explanation_en: BAC measures how much alcohol is present in a person’s bloodstream. It helps determine if a driver is under the influence of alcohol and is commonly used in law enforcement for DUI (driving under the influence) cases.

question_en: You were flagged down due to noisy muffler of your motorcycle, what will you do?
option_b_en: reinstall the stock muffler of your motorcycle
explanation_en: Modified or noisy mufflers are illegal because they cause noise pollution and disturb public peace. To comply with LTO regulations, the rider must replace the modified muffler with the original one.

question_en: Steady green light means:
option_a_en: you must yield to all pedestrians and other motorists using the intersection
option_b_en: go, it is safe to do so
option_c_en: proceed cautiously through the intersection before the light changes to red
explanation_en: A steady green light means you are allowed to proceed through the intersection, but only if the way is clear and it’s safe. You must still check for pedestrians and vehicles that may not have cleared the intersection yet.

question_en: The headlights should be used often as needed to:
option_a_en: make your intentions known to drivers around you
option_b_en: to signal to other drivers you have the right of way
option_c_en: to let other drivers know you are approaching
explanation_en: Headlights are mainly used so that you can see and be seen by others, especially in low visibility conditions like at night, during rain, or in fog. Using them helps other drivers recognize that your vehicle is approaching, reducing the risk of collisions. They are not meant to claim right of way or show your intentions, but to improve safety and visibility on the road.

question_en: It is more dangerous to drive at the maximum speed limit at night than during daytime because:
option_a_en: your reaction time is slower at night
option_b_en: the roadways are more slippery at night
option_c_en: you cannot see too far ahead at night
explanation_en: Imposed speed limits on roads are recommended under the assumption that the roads are in the best condition (i.e. dry, without potholes or heavy traffic, good lighting). Let's say you're driving at night in an expressway with poor lighting, you wouldn't want to drive close to the max speed limit; instead, you would want to drive slower than the maximum speed limit and not slower than the minimum speed limit because it's safer to do so.

question_en: Who are required to wear a prescribed helmet?
option_a_en: all bikers, skaters, and riders are required to wear helmets with ICC sticker at all times
option_b_en: all bikers, skaters, and riders are required to wear helmets at all times
option_c_en: all motorcycle riders are required to wear helmets with ICC sticker at all times
explanation_en: It's mandated by law that all motorbike riders must wear helmets with ICC stickers.

question_en: When driving downhill on a mountain road always:
option_a_en: be always prepared to hit the brakes
option_c_en: shift to low gear so the engine braking action can help you control your speed
explanation_en: When driving downhill, using a low gear allows the engine to slow down the vehicle naturally through engine braking, reducing reliance on the brakes. This prevents the brakes from overheating or failing, which can happen if you use them continuously on steep slopes. Being prepared to brake is important, but shifting to low gear is the safer, primary method for controlling speed on downhill mountain roads.

question_en: The purpose of traffic laws, rules and regulations is to:
option_b_en: establish an orderly movement of vehicles and pedestrian traffic and penalties
explanation_en: Traffic rules and regulation is implemented for organizational and safety reasons so all motorists and road users must follow them.

question_en: The speed limit prescribed by law does not apply to a driver:
option_a_en: bringing his employer to an important official meeting
option_b_en: of a vehicle who is in pursuit of criminal
option_c_en: operating along the highway where traffic is light
explanation_en: Any law-enforcement officer in pursuit of a criminal is exempted from the mandatory speed limit.

question_en: The deadline to renew the registration of a motor vehicle is:
option_a_en: at the discretion of the operator
option_b_en: at the end of the year
option_c_en: on the last working day of the month corresponding to the last digit of the motor vehicle plates
explanation_en: Vehicle registration is required yearly and its schedule is based on the last digit of the vehicle's plate number.

question_en: If the brake lights of several cars ahead of you flash on, you should:
option_a_en: release accelerator and prepare to brake
option_b_en: apply your brakes as soon as possible
explanation_en: When you see brake lights ahead, it means traffic is slowing down. You should ease off the accelerator and get ready to brake smoothly to avoid sudden stops and prevent rear-end collisions.

question_en: If the driver is using a motor vehicle in committing a crime and is convicted, his driver’s license shall be:
option_a_en: revokes and will pay a fine
explanation_en: If a driver uses a vehicle to commit a crime, it is considered a serious offense. The LTO permanently revokes the driver’s license and imposes a fine as part of the penalty.

question_en: Operating a public utility vehicle equipped with stereo-music is punishable by:
option_b_en: revocation of the license and registration certificate
option_c_en: imprisonment of the driver and operator for six months
explanation_en: Public utility vehicles are meant for passenger transport, not entertainment. Playing loud music can distract both the driver and passengers, which may lead to accidents. That’s why the law imposes a fine for this violation.

question_en: When approaching a flooded area and you have to go through it, what should you do?
option_a_en: increase your speed so you get through immediately
option_b_en: maintain your speed as most have water insulation anyways
option_c_en: proceed at a very slow speed
explanation_en: When driving through floodwater, you should move very slowly to avoid creating waves that can push water into your engine or cause you to lose control. Driving fast can cause water to splash into the engine or exhaust, leading to stalling or damage. Keeping a steady, slow speed helps maintain traction and reduces the risk of engine flooding or losing control.

question_en: Road accidents can be avoided and minimized if the driver:
option_a_en: don’t disregard traffic signs installed in particular places
option_b_en: drinks coffee before hitting the road
explanation_en: Traffic signs are placed to guide and warn drivers about road conditions, hazards, and rules. Following these signs helps prevent accidents by ensuring everyone on the road understands when to stop, slow down, or yield. While careful driving and staying alert are important, obeying traffic signs is a key safety measure because they are designed to maintain order and reduce risk for all road users.

question_en: When approaching an intersection and the roadway beyond is blocked with traffic, you should:
option_a_en: keep as close as possible to the car ahead
option_b_en: proceed slowly into the intersection until the traffic ahead moves on
option_c_en: stop before the intersection and wait until traffic ahead moves on
explanation_en: Moving slowly into the intersection allows you to maintain position and flow once traffic clears. However, you must ensure it’s safe and not blocking other lanes. It helps prevent congestion behind you while staying alert for movement ahead.

question_en: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slopes in towards your left. This shows that:
option_a_en: there is an intersection joint ahead
option_c_en: you are approaching a construction area
explanation_en: A slanting solid white line on the right edge of the road indicates that the lane or roadway is narrowing ahead, warning drivers to slow down and stay within their lane.

question_en: What should you prepare for a long trip?
option_a_en: prepare the necessary tools that can be used to repair the vehicle
option_b_en: plan the route and make sure the vehicle is in good condition
explanation_en: Before heading out on a long trip you should plan your route, prepare your vehicle toolbox, and make sure your vehicle is in good condition for a long drive.

question_en: A flashing yellow light at a road crossing signifies:
option_a_en: Caution - slow down and proceed with caution
option_b_en: stop and stay until light stops flashing
explanation_en: A flashing yellow light warns drivers that they are approaching a potentially dangerous area, such as an intersection or pedestrian crossing. It doesn’t mean stop, but it tells you to slow down and stay alert.

question_en: When using the basic speed law as a guide, the choice of speed is based on the:
explanation_en: Speed limits are based on traffic and overall condition of the road. That's why speed limits vary on different highways and roads here in the Philippines. E.g. 100kph in expressways for cars (80kph for trucks/buses); 40kph on avenues and boulevards (30kph for trucks/buses); 30kph on city and town streets; 20kph on crowded streets; 10kph on other private subdivision streets.

question_en: What documents must you carry along whenever you drive a "for hire" vehicle?
option_a_en: Non-professional driver’s license, and current OR/C
option_b_en: Professional driver’s license, and current OR/CR
explanation_en: Professional drivers are those who drive for a living. To do that they must have a Professional driver's license.

question_en: A public utility vehicle can only be driven by holder of a:
explanation_en: One can only drive PUVs or PUJs if he possesses a professional driver's license.

question_en: Chances of being hurt or killed while driving/riding are reduced if one is wearing:
explanation_en: A seat belt is a vehicle safety device designed to secure the driver or a passenger of a vehicle against harmful movement that may result during a collision or a sudden stop.

question_en: Which of the following traffic signs are blue?
explanation_en: Blue traffic signs are used to provide helpful information or directions to drivers, such as the location of hospitals, parking areas, or gas stations. They are meant to guide and assist road users, not to warn or regulate.

question_en: What light shall be used when vehicles are parked on the highway at night?
explanation_en: When a vehicle is parked on the highway at night, parking lights or low-beam headlights should be used to make the vehicle visible to other drivers. This helps prevent accidents and ensures road safety in dark conditions.

question_en: Those who are caught under the influence of prohibited drugs or alcohol while driving shall be penalized with:
explanation_en: Drivers caught under the influence of drugs or alcohol can face both penalties — suspension or revocation of their driver’s license and either fines or imprisonment under traffic and safety laws.

question_en: What should you do when approaching a curve?
explanation_en: When approaching a curve, you should reduce your speed before entering the curve. Slowing down gives your tires better traction and control, helping prevent skidding or losing balance. Speeding up or braking suddenly while turning can make your vehicle slide or lose control, especially on wet or sharp curves.

question_en: You should change lanes only after you have:
option_a_en: signaled your intention and checked traffic
explanation_en: Before changing lanes, you must signal your intention to alert other drivers and check the traffic to make sure the lane is clear and safe. Doing both helps prevent collisions and ensures smooth traffic flow.

question_en: When driving on the highway at night, you should use low beam headlights (dim lights) when:
option_b_en: blinded by the headlights of an approaching vehicle
explanation_en: Low beam headlights should be used at night when another driver dims their lights or when you are blinded by the headlights of an oncoming vehicle. Using low beams prevents glare that can affect other drivers’ vision and keeps everyone safe on the road.

question_en: Children must be held in approved child restraint if they are:
explanation_en: It is mandatory for children aged 6 years old and below to wear proper child restraint.

question_en: In traffic direction and control, when both the traffic lights and law enforcer are directing traffic, which will you follow to avoid confusion?
explanation_en: Traffic enforcers can overrule traffic lights so when both are present you may ignore the traffic lights and follow the traffic enforcer's direction.

question_en: When loading or unloading passengers, we usually stop at the:
option_a_en: right side of the road nearest the sidewalk
explanation_en: Stopping on the right side of the road nearest the sidewalk allows passengers to get on or off safely without blocking traffic or putting themselves in danger from moving vehicles.
